senses.gloss: m. (a comp. of זל, v. זלל, a. דְּקַן) thin-bearded, one with a downy beard.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 100b:8">Snh. 100ᵇ</cite> (a citation fr. Ben Sira) <he>ז׳ קורטמן</he> (Ms. M. <he>דלדקן</he>, Var. <he>דל דקן</he>, <he>זיל ד׳</he> &c., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a thin-bearded person is sharp-minded.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:1:4">Y. Taan. IV, beg. 67ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:8:2">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᶜ</cite> top <he>הוה מעבר ז׳</he> removed one with a downy beard (from pronouncing the priestly benediction).
